first_pass: Retain all 36 historical and 24 extension attempts, including incomplete ones.
retry_selection: All seven incomplete extension slots; historical search-B-R3 excluded.
replacement_policy: Use the retry for all seven selected slots, including worse or incomplete results; never best-of-two or question merging.
runtime: Historical runtime source hashes and model settings restored for extension and retries; published application is a later packaging revision.
history: Continue complete historical assignments; rolling last 30; retries continue current history.
cache: Warm cache snapshot at extension start; original historical cache cannot be reconstructed; retries continue current cache.
latency: Time to local export; only complete, unassisted attempts within 3600 seconds. Selected latency excludes superseded attempts and inter-attempt waiting.
repeat: Complete assignments only. Maximum one-to-one identity matching / smaller question count for each same-request round pair, then pair mean per request, then request macro mean.
finite_oracles: Finite post-hoc algorithm checks; some input/output codecs are shared with production verification; not universal independent correctness.
public_scope: Numeric records, sanitized request descriptions and pair counts. Private course attachments, question bodies, programs, hidden cases, caches and traces are excluded.
reproduction_limit: Public checks reproduce arithmetic, not the private content judgments or historical live run environment.
